ctx.x: Did you have a score pad on the bus?

Sometimes. Sometimes I did. I eventually got a score pad. But usually I would just write it out. You’d be surprised what I used to write on. Sometimes I’d draw a staff and write on the staff you know. But yeah, I finally got that score pad, when I found out what a score pad was. And I said, oh you can do it? It’s already written out? You know, so that was a shortcut for me, when I found out what a score pad was. You know David Matthews and Emile Charlap, they helped me a lot. In fact they kind of taught me how to

write, things that I didn’t know how to write. And all that stuff, I said well how do you write for French horns, or how do you write for strings, the violin. And they would tell me, and I’ve got a whole year of education by just asking the question you know?
